End an experiment for good with a winner: its paywalls show to everyone at its locations, and the
flags it set give its values to everyone their own rules and overrides don't name. It can never run
again. Shows the results and asks first; --yes skips the question.

Usage:
  voidhash experiment conclude [experiment] [flags]

Arguments:
  experiment  The experiment's name or id

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --winner <arm>       The winning arm by name (default: the control)
  -y, --yes                Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash experiment conclude "Annual-first onboarding" --winner "Annual first"
  voidhash experiment conclude exp_123 --winner control --yes
